items.text: Kwathi sezibuthene izigidi ezinengi zabantu baze banyathelana, waqala ukukhuluma, ikakhulu labafundi bakhe, esithi: Xwayani imvubelo yabaFarisi eyikuzenzisa.
Mat 16:6
Mark 8:15
Kakukho okumbomboziweyo okungayikwambulwa, lokufihliweyo okungayikwaziwa;
Mark 4:22
Luka 8:17
lalokho elikukhuluma emnyameni kuzakuzwiwa ekukhanyeni, lelikunyenyezileyo ezindlini kuzakumenyezelwa phezu kwezindlu.
Ngithi kini bangane bami: Lingabesabi labo ababulala umzimba, bengelakwenza lutho emva kwalokho.
Kodwa ngizakulitshengisa elifanele ukumesaba: Mesabeni lowo othi esebulele, abe lamandla okuphosela esihogweni. Yebo, ngithi kini: Mesabeni lowo.
Kakuthengwa yini intaka ezinhlanu ngendibilitshi ezimbili na? Kanti emehlweni kaNkulunkulu kakukhohlakali lanye yazo.
Kanti lenwele zekhanda lenu zibaliwe zonke. Lingesabi lina, ngoba liyazidlula intaka ezinengi.
Njalo ngithi kini: Yilowo lalowo ongivuma phambi kwabantu, leNdodana yomuntu layo izakumvuma phambi kwezithunywa zikaNkulunkulu;
kodwa ongiphika phambi kwabantu uzakuphikwa phambi kwezithunywa zikaNkulunkulu.
Yilowo lalowo okhuluma ilizwi elibi ngeNdodana yomuntu uzakuthethelelwa, kodwa lowo ohlambaza uMoya oNgcwele kayikuthethelelwa.
Mark 3:29
Nxa belisa emasinagogeni, laphambi kwababusi leziphathamandla, lingaphisekeli ukuthi lizakuziphendulela kanjani, lokuthi lizakukhulumani,
Mark 13:11
ngoba uMoya oNgcwele uzakulifundisa ngalesosikhathi lokho elifanele ukukukhuluma.
Omunye wexuku wathi kuye: Mfundisi, akutshele umfowethu abelane lami ilifa.
Kodwa wathi kuye: Ndoda, ngubani ongimise ukuba ngibe ngumthonisisi loba umahlukanisi wempahla kini na?
Wasesithi kibo: Xwayani, liqaphele ubuhwaba bonke, ngoba ukusila komuntu kakuyi ngobunengi bempahla yakhe.
Wasebatshela umfanekiso esithi: Ilizwe lendoda ethile enothileyo lathela kakhulu.
Wanakana lokhu esithi: Ngizakwenza njani na? Ngoba kangilandawo lapho ngingabuthela khona amabele ami.
Wasesithi: Ngizakwenza lokhu, ngizakudiliza iziphala zami, ngakhe ezinkulu, ngibuthele khona amabele ami lempahla yami.
Besengisithi kumphefumulo wami: Mphefumulo, ulempahla ezinengi ezibekelwe iminyaka eminengi; phumula, udle, unathe, uthokoze.
Kodwa uNkulunkulu wathi kuye: Wena siphukuphuku, ngalobubusuku umphefumulo wakho uzakubizwa. Phoke, izinto ozilungisileyo zizakuba ngezikabani na?
Kunjaloke kozibekela inotho yena enganothanga kuNkulunkulu.
Wasesithi kubafundi bakhe: Ngakhoke ngithi kini: Lingaphisekeli ukusila kwenu ukuba lizakudlani, loba umzimba wenu ukuba lizakwambathani.
Ngoba ukusila kwedlula ukudla, lomzimba wedlula izambatho.
Qaphelisisani amawabayi ukuthi kawahlanyeli, kawavuni, kawalaziphala loba izilulu, kanti uNkulunkulu uyawondla. Lina liyazidlula kakhulu inyoni.
Nguwuphi kini ongathi ngokuphisekela engezelele ingalo ibenye ebudeni bakhe na?
Ngakhoke nxa lingelamandla okwenza into encinyane nje, liphisekelani ngokunye na?
Qaphelisisani imiduze ukuthi ikhula kanjani; kayiphothi, kayaluki, kodwa ngithi kini loSolomoni ebucwazicwazini bakhe bonke wayengambathiswanga njengomunye wayo.
Uba uNkulunkulu esambathisa ngokunjalo utshani beganga obukhona lamuhla, kusasa buphoswa eziko, uzakulambathisa ngokukhulu kangakanani lina elilokukholwa okuncinyane.
Lanike lingadingi elizakukudla lelizakukunatha; lingakhathazeki.
Ngoba konke lokhu kufunwa yizizwe zomhlaba; kodwa uYihlo uyazi ukuthi liyakuswela lokhu.
Kodwa funani umbuso wakhe, zonke lezizinto zizakwengezelelwa kini.
Lingesabi, mhlambi omncinyane; ngoba kuyikuthanda kukaYihlo ukulinika umbuso.
Thengisani impahla zenu, liphe iziphiwo; lizenzele imixhaka engagugiyo lenotho engapheliyo ezulwini, lapho kungasondeli isela khona, lalapho inondo ingoni khona.
Ngoba lapho kukhona inotho yenu, izakuba khona lapho lenhliziyo yenu.
Inkalo zenu kazihlale zibotshiwe, lezibane zenu zihlale zivutha;
lani libe njengabantu abalindele inkosi yabo ukuba ibuye ekhaya ivela emthimbeni, ukuze nxa ifika, iqoqoda, bayivulele masinyane.
Zibusisiwe lezonceku okuzakuthi, inkosi nxa ifika, izifumane zilindile. Ngiqinisile ngithi kini: Izakubopha ukhalo lwayo, izihlalise ekudleni, iziphakululele.
Loba ifika ngomlindo wesibili ingabe ngowesithathu, izifumane zinjalo, zibusisiwe lezonceku.
Kodwa yazini lokhu kokuthi, uba umninindlu ubesazile isikhathi isela elizakufika ngaso, ubengayikuvuma ukuba indlu yakhe ifohlelwe.
Lanike hlalani lilungile, ngoba iNdodana yomuntu iyeza ngesikhathi elingayilindele ngaso.
UPetro wathi: Nkosi, uwutshela thina sodwa lumfanekiso ingabe utshela bonke na?
INkosi yasisithi: Nguwuphi umphathi wezinceku othembekileyo lohlakaniphileyo, inkosi yakhe ezakumbeka phezu kwabendlu yayo ukuba abanike isabelo sabo sokudla ngesikhathi esifaneleyo na?
Ibusisiwe leyonceku okuzakuthi inkosi yayo, nxa ifika, iyifumane isenza njalo.
Ngiqinisile ngithi kini: Izakuyibeka phezu kwakho konke elakho.
Kodwa nxa leyonceku inakana isithi: Inkosi yami iphuzile ukubuya; ibisiqala ukuhlupha izinceku lezincekukazi, idle, inathe, idakwe,
inkosi yaleyonceku izakufika ngosuku engayilindele ngalo langesikhathi engasaziyo, izakuyiqumaquma, iyabele labangathembekanga.
Njaloke laleyonceku ebisazi intando yenkosi yayo ingalungiselanga, ingenzanga ngokwentando yenkosi yayo, izakutshaywa imivimvinya eminengi.

Kodwa leyo ebingayazi yenza okufanele ukutshaywa, izakutshaywa imivimvinya eyingcosana; ilowo lalowo ophiwe okunengi, kuzakubizwa okunengi kuye; lalowo ophathiswe okunengi, kuzakubizwa kuye okungaphezu kwalokho.
Ngize ukuphemba umlilo emhlabeni; bengifisa kakhulu ukuba ngabe usulumethe.
Ngilobhaphathizo engizakubhaphathizwa ngalo; ngikhathazekile kakhulu, luze luphelele.
Mark 10:38
Lithi ngize ukuletha ukuthula emhlabeni na? Ngithi kini: Atshi, ngilethe ukwahlukana.
Ngoba kusukela kulesisikhathi kuzakuba khona abahlanu endlininye bahlukane phakathi, abathathu balwe lababili, lababili balwe labathathu;
bazakwahlukana, uyise alwe lendodana, indodana ilwe loyise; unina alwe lendodakazi, indodakazi ilwe lonina; uninazala alwe lomalokazana, umalokazana alwe loninazala.
Mika 7:6
Wasesithi emaxukwini: Nxa libona iyezi liphuma entshonalanga, lihle lithi: Lizakukhiza. Kube njalo.
Nxa lisizwa kuphephetha umoya waseningizimu, lithi: Lizakutshisa. Kube njalo.
Lina bazenzisi! liyakwazi ukuchasisa ukuma komhlaba lomkhathi; kodwa kungani lingakwazi ukuchasisa lesisikhathi na?
Pho, kungani ukuba lingazikhetheli lina uqobo lwenu okulungileyo na?
Nxa usiya phambi komthonisisi lalowo omangalelene laye, lisesendleleni mncenge ukuba akukhulule, funa akudonsele kumthonisisi, lomthonisisi akunikele kulo inxusa, lenxusa likuphose entolongweni.
Ngithi kuwe kawusoze waphuma khona, uze ukhokhe indibilitshi yokucina.
